svg.title: Pulkit Chauhan
svg.desc: Pulkit Chauhan. C++ systems engineer: order books, databases and open source. Final-year computer science student at UPES, graduating May 2027, open to software engineering roles from January 2027. 8.9 million messages a second through his NASDAQ order book engine. A C++ fix merged into OpenCV, with more work in review at ClickHouse. Peak Codeforces rating 1986, Candidate Master. Google Summer of Code 2026 with CCExtractor.
